title: Good Time!  Excellent Tour!
text:
Confirmation #T2TAP30241

We are a family of 4.  We had a GREAT time with our two tour guides.  They were both lively and engaging!  I am bilingual but my family is not, and the tour guides both easily shared information in English and politely indulged my Spanish.  We really enjoyed walking down the main shopping streets and looking at the various architectural styles of the buildings. They shared great history notes and local culture. The Tapas that were selected were great new foods to try and we really enjoyed these local favorites.  I / we would definitely do this again — but wear good wa
